title: Symbol
author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
paragraphs: A symbol is a drawing, shape, or an object that represents an idea, object, or amount of something.

The most common symbols are letters, which are symbols of words and sounds. A symbol can be an actual object (such as the cross, a symbol of Christianity or a scepter, a symbol of royalty and power), or a certain color or pattern.
Symbols are used often in poetry and other types of literature, sometimes as metaphors or similes. A national emblem is a symbol for a certain country.

There are thousands of symbols that are recognized by most people all over the world, and many more that are limited to certain regions, religions and sciences. Some of the best known ones are listed below.
Cadillac -> top of the line (in USA only)
Cowboys and Indians -> the old Western USA
Fleur-de-lis -> scouts, the Canadian city of Quebec
Owl -> wisdom/education (western worlds), may mean evil in other place.
Pine tree and crane -> long life (Chinese)
Volvo cars -> bad/elderly drivers (Australia), prestige (European Union), Sweden
